title: conda activation drops Intel runtime from LD_LIBRARY_PATH (exit code 127)
symptom: Remote job exits 127 immediately; libifcore.so.5 / MKL runtime 'not found'.
root_cause: Activating a conda environment rewrites LD_LIBRARY_PATH without the Intel Fortran/MKL runtime directories.
minimal_fix: In the same shell, source Intel oneAPI setvars.sh AFTER conda activate; verify dynamic resolution (ldd) before submitting; run in a fresh -r1 directory.
validation: Binary resolves all Intel libraries and the job starts.
avoid: Copying library files around, or diagnosing 127 as an application crash.

parameters.order: source oneAPI setvars.sh AFTER conda activate; verify with ldd
